title: MACHINES DRAW FASTER
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the sprites, and the graphics rule that every sprite stays cheap. The redrawn Sentry and Crawler cost seventy-odd separate drawing calls each, every frame, for parts that never change from one frame to the next. Their still parts (hull, tread, head, shell) are now painted once into a small picture and stamped in one go; only what moves or speaks is drawn every frame: tread teeth, legs, antenna, the eye and its glow, the windup, the turning gun and its flash. The stamp is made at the size the screen draws it, so 4K stays sharp, and is remade when that size changes. A fight with many machines costs less, and nothing looks different. With the internal wall bake switch off (CFG.wallBake 0) everything is drawn live as before.
now: The Sentry and the Crawler draw faster: their still parts are stamped from a baked picture.
